notes: On a TV the remote stays on the page: up and down move between rows instead of jumping to the side menu, left opens the menu on the page you are on, and whatever you are on wears a clear white ring. Home shows a complete first row under a shorter banner, cards in a row line up, a search hands the remote straight to the results, a title with no streams tells you what to do next, and the pause screen's end time always agrees with the clock.
